name: Xericeps
isnote: Consistently recovered with Alanqa and Leptostomia in Alanqidae, whose position within Azhdarchoidea is debated.
sum: Toothless pterosaur with a forceps-like, upturned beak from the Kem Kem beds of Morocco.
wsnote: Probably near the lower end of 3–8 m.
holotype: FSAC-KK-10700 — Kem Kem Group, Aferdou N'Chaft, near Hassi el Begaa, Morocco.
material: Fragmented front of the lower jaw.
biology: Upturned forceps-like beak; alanqids are thought to have fed on molluscs or by probing.
author: Martill et al. 2018
